newsitem.title: USA: Smith Barney adjusts N.Y. Dorm free-to-trade time.
newsitem.headline: Smith Barney adjusts N.Y. Dorm free-to-trade time.

text.p: Smith Barney Inc said Friday it adjusted the effective time syndicate restrictions will be removed on the Dormitory Authority of the State of New York's $395 million bond issue.
The firm said the restrictions will be removed and the bonds free to trade at 1015 EDT. An earlier statement from Smith Barney said the bonds would free up at 1000 EDT.
DORMITORY AUTHORITY OF THE STATE OF NEW YORK
CITY UNIVERSITY SYSTEM CONSOLIDATED REVENUE BONDS
Effective at 10:15 A.M. E.D.T., Friday, August 30, 1996
all syndicate terms and price restrictions are removed
and the bonds will be free to trade.
